prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production game terrain background, SQUARE 1024x1024. Beautiful premium hand-painted 3D miniature coastal island viewed almost directly from above, sea teal, pale weathered limestone, low mossy grass, tiny flowers, fractured coastal cliffs and foam along edges.
